about.title: Redefining How Engineers Think, Learn, and Build
about.subtitle: C³ MindLoop was created to bridge developer reality with intelligent software tools.
about.brandSectionDesc: The name isn't random. Every part of it describes exactly what developers go through, and what this platform was built around.
about.brandC3Desc: The superscript ³ stands for the three things every developer actually does every day. You write code. Something breaks. You spend hours reading cryptic stack traces, question every decision you made, and eventually fix it. Then you ship. That loop is the job. C³ MindLoop exists because that reality deserves to be named, not dressed up.
about.brandMindTitle: The loop inside your head that never shuts off.
about.brandMindDesc: You're in the shower thinking about a race condition. You wake up at 3am knowing exactly why the client-side JSON Formatter was throwing on nested nulls. That's the developer mind, always running, always iterating. MindLoop is that cycle: Think, Build, Learn, Repeat. Not a motivational poster. Just what actually happens when you care about your craft.
about.brandLoopTitle: It never stops. That's the point.
about.brandLoopDesc: There's no finish line in software. Every shipped feature opens three more problems. Every solved bug teaches you something that changes how you write the next function. Whether you're building a client-side Base64 Encoder or a distributed auth system, the loop is the work. The faster you get at running it, the better your software gets.
about.brandPrivacyTitle: 100% Local Browser Execution. Zero Server Data Logging.
about.brandPrivacyDesc: Every private browser utility on this platform, including the client-side JSON Formatter, JWT Decoder, and Base64 Encoder, runs entirely in your browser. No data leaves your machine. No server logs your input. We built it this way because that's the only way we'd want to use it ourselves.
about.storyP1: C³ MindLoop started with a simple realization: software engineering isn't a linear path of clean code. It's a continuous loop of hypothesis, execution, crash, and insight.
about.storyP2: Today, C³ MindLoop brings together developer educational resources, AI experimentation, open-source projects, and micro-SaaS tooling.
about.p1Desc: Authentic developer connection where engineers share real challenges, bugs, and lessons learned.
about.p2Desc: Building software tools that eliminate developer friction and enhance productivity.
about.p3Desc: The perpetual feedback loop that drives continuous personal growth and product improvement.
about.val1Desc: We build minimal, fast, elegant software that respects developer time and focus.
about.val2Desc: No fake benchmarks, no exaggerated claims. We focus on real code, real learning, and real solutions.
about.val3Desc: Empowering developers through open-source code, guides, and accessible tools.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.heroSubtitle: At C³ MindLoop, data privacy is not an afterthought. It is built into our core architecture. Learn how our local-first browser execution protects your code and credentials.
privacy.section1Body: Unlike traditional developer utility websites that send your input data to remote servers via network calls, C³ MindLoop executes all processing directly inside your local web browser. Whether you are formatting complex JSON, decoding JWT authorization tokens, converting Base64 strings, or evaluating Regex patterns, every operation relies exclusively on your device's native browser engines, such as Web APIs and JavaScript runtimes. No payload, raw code, API key, or credential ever leaves your browser or gets transmitted across the internet.
privacy.section2Title: 2. Zero Data Collection, Retention, and Logging
privacy.section2Body: We operate under a strict Zero Data Retention policy. We do not store, log, monitor, inspect, or backup any data that you paste, type, or process within our tools. Because all processing happens offline on your client machine, we have zero access to your internal payloads, proprietary source code, or confidential tokens. There is no server-side database receiving your input. There never was.
privacy.section3Title: 3. Local Storage and Browser State Management
privacy.section3Body: To provide a seamless experience, such as remembering your active workspace settings, UI preferences, or temporary tool history, C³ MindLoop may use local browser storage mechanisms like localStorage and sessionStorage. This data lives strictly on your local machine. It is never transmitted to us or any third party, and you can clear it completely at any time through your browser settings.
privacy.section4Body: C³ MindLoop is designed to be completely ad-free and tracking-light. We do not use third-party advertising networks, cross-site trackers, or invasive data-mining cookies. We may collect non-identifiable, aggregated technical metrics such as page view counts, browser type, and country-level location, solely to monitor server status, system performance, and bandwidth utilization. These metrics contain zero payload data and zero personal identifiers.
privacy.section5Title: 5. Outgoing Client Requests and API Testing
privacy.section5Body: If you use our API and cURL testing utilities to trigger HTTP or REST requests, those requests originate directly from your web browser to your targeted destination endpoint. C³ MindLoop does not proxy, inspect, reroute, or log your API request bodies or headers. The connection is yours, end to end.
privacy.section6Body: C³ MindLoop incorporates verified open-source software libraries to handle specific formatting and parsing functions. These libraries run strictly inside your local browser environment and have no network access to external servers. We periodically review open-source components to ensure compliance with security standards and licensing requirements.
privacy.section7Body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect architecture upgrades or new browser capabilities. Continued use of C³ MindLoop implies acceptance of the current policy. If you have questions about our client-side architecture or want to inspect how the tools work, feel free to reach out or browse our codebase on GitHub.
